grammar.title: Necessity with 必须
grammar.explanation: 必须 (bìxū) means "must, have to" stronger and more formal than 要. It emphasizes that something is required, with no other option.

grammar.title: Adding information with 而且
grammar.explanation: 而且 (érqiě) means "moreover, and also" it adds a second, often stronger point to what was just said. It is often paired with 也 or 都 in the second clause, and later pairs with the stronger 不但...而且.

sentences.zh: 这个电影很好看，而且很长。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège diànyǐng hěn hǎokàn, érqiě hěn cháng.
sentences.en: This movie is good, and it's also long.

sentences.zh: 我今天很忙，而且没有时间。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān hěn máng, érqiě méiyǒu shíjiān.
sentences.en: I'm busy today, and I also don't have time.

sentences.zh: 这家公司很大，而且很有名。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī hěn dà, érqiě hěn yǒumíng.
sentences.en: This company is big, and it's also famous.

sentences.zh: 他会说汉语，而且说得很好。
sentences.pinyin: Tā huì shuō Hànyǔ, érqiě shuō de hěn hǎo.
sentences.en: He can speak Chinese, and he speaks it well.
